# R1 evals — Foundation: scoped theme, fonts, app scope wrapper, ten primitives

Run all commands from the worktree root (`.claude/worktrees/flat-redesign`). Source of truth: `docs/build/redesign-spec.md`, "Rules" and "R1 Foundation". Every check is PASS only if the stated expectation holds; any other result is FAIL.

## Preamble (paste once per shell, before R1-02..R1-11)

`TOK` checks that each `name=value` pair is declared in `src/styles/app-theme.css` under ALL FOUR required selectors (`html:has(.kv-app)`, `.kv-app`, `html[data-theme="dark"]:has(.kv-app)`, `[data-theme="dark"] .kv-app`). It compares values with whitespace removed and case ignored. Exit 0 = all present, exit 1 = prints `MISSING name value under selector`.

```sh
TOK() { node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const css=fs.readFileSync("src/styles/app-theme.css","utf8").replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,"");const rules=[...css.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}/g)].map(m=>({sel:m[1].split(",").map(s=>s.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ")),body:m[2]}));const S=["html:has(.kv-app)",".kv-app","html[data-theme=\"dark\"]:has(.kv-app)","[data-theme=\"dark\"] .kv-app"];let bad=0;for(const a of process.argv.slice(1)){const i=a.indexOf("=");const k=a.slice(0,i),v=a.slice(i+1).replace(/\s+/g,"");for(const s of S){const ok=rules.some(r=>r.sel.includes(s)&&r.body.split(";").some(d=>{const j=d.indexOf(":");return j>0&&d.slice(0,j).trim()===k&&d.slice(j+1).replace(/\s+/g,"").toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase()}));if(!ok){bad=1;console.error("MISSING",k,v,"under",s)}}}process.exit(bad)' -- "$@"; }
```

Builder implements this file. Conventions (copied from `tests/components/ui-tile.test.tsx`): first line `// @vitest-environment jsdom`; `import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest"`; `import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, act } from "@testing-library/react"`; `afterEach(cleanup)`; import primitives from `@/components/ui` (the index) so R1-26 is exercised; use `vi.useFakeTimers()` and restore with `vi.useRealTimers()` in `afterEach`. No new dependency (do not add `@testing-library/user-event` or `jest-dom`). Each primitive has its own `describe` named exactly after the component, and the `it` titles below must exist verbatim.

R1-40. test file exists with all titles — cmd: `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("tests/components/kv-primitives.test.tsx","utf8");const T=["Button defaults to primary md idle","Button busy disables, sets aria-busy and shows busyLabel","Button busy spinner appears only after 250ms","Button done disables and shows tick and doneLabel","Button arrow appends arrow and hides it when busy or done","Button fires onClick when idle and not when busy or done","Signal dot is aria-hidden and followed by children","Signal pill renders a leading dot and data-kind for every kind","Field wraps label and control and sets no alert without error","Field error renders role alert and data-invalid","Segmented has group role, aria-label and one button per option","Segmented marks the selected option aria-pressed and calls onChange","Switch is a role switch named by label and reflects aria-checked","Switch calls onChange with the toggled value","Card renders div, a and button and keeps native props","Card tone and clickable variants render distinct classes","Ring is an img named by label with the label as centre text","Ring default kind is ok at 100 and warn below","Bar is a progressbar with aria-valuenow 0 to 100 and aria-label","Bar clamps value outside 0 to 1","InlineStatus always renders its container before content","InlineStatus error uses role alert and other kinds role status","InlineStatus ok shows a tick","Tabs has tablist role, aria-label and aria-selected tabs","Tabs ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move selection"];const miss=T.filter(t=>!s.includes(t));if(miss.length){console.error(miss);process.exit(1)}'` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if no title is missing.
